notes: The middle RGB image encodes signed horizontal differences in red and signed vertical differences in blue. A shared contrast curve sign(z) min(|z|/s,1)^0.45, with s equal to the pooled 98.5th absolute-gradient percentile, strengthens weak components and clips only the display tails. Red and blue channels equal 0.5 plus half this signed curve; green stays at 0.5. The gradient arrays themselves are unchanged. Zero gradient is neutral gray; increasing/decreasing channels distinguish signs. The final panel is the actual Euclidean magnitude. Periodic div=-gradient-adjoint is verified.
